Launch-to-paint includes producer container startup, backend warmup, ingestion and the Explorer refresh interval; it is not publish-to-paint latency.

WebSocket frame counts include all data protocol traffic during each phase, including background work; they are not decoded query counts.

Orderly Compose restart including shutdown, command and validator startup; not native pod cold/warm startup or crash recovery.
Two count-based retention/JSON export/import cycles after ingestion. Background pollers remain active; no concurrent new event publication or replay claim.
Allocation/file checkpoints measure observed space after deletion/refill, not forced compaction or filesystem reclamation.
